entries.what: Brakes lab 8-11 at Tamsen Valley, then a quiet lunch in the truck. That night he asks the assistant for a calm routine for the morning of the G1 practice test, including what to eat.
entries.outcome: Got a simple plan: early bed, eggs and toast, no energy drink, short drive in.

entries.what: Pickup soccer at Delgado Park Monday evening with a few guys from class.
entries.outcome: Sweated out some nerves and went home to shower.

entries.what: Watched an engine teardown video in bed and listened to his voice-memo flashcards once more before sleeping around midnight.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep with the flashcards still playing.

entries.what: Up at 6:30 for the G1 practice test day. Ate eggs and toast, then drove the Taco to Tamsen Valley.
entries.outcome: Arrived early with time to spare in Lot C.

entries.what: Sat the ASE G1 practice test on the scheduled day, using the calm routine and taking his time on each question.
entries.outcome: Finished with minutes left and did not change his answers this time.

entries.what: Engine performance with Salas 1-4, where he diagnosed a misfire by ear and kept his bay spotless.
entries.outcome: Salas nodded at the clean bay; Dante asked again about the Civic.

entries.what: Brakes lab 8-11, then ran errands in the Taco for his mom, including a pork pickup at Ruiz Family Market.
entries.outcome: Got the family price on pork shoulder for the weekend.

entries.what: Serviced the stand's generator in the driveway after lunch.
entries.outcome: Generator ran clean; his dad said it sounded good.

entries.what: Called Ximena at night to talk about her upcoming weekend after her birthday dinner.
entries.outcome: Planned to see her at the stand Saturday.

entries.what: Engine performance class 1-4 with Salas and Dante.
entries.outcome: Finished the lab on time and cleaned the bay.

entries.what: Worked the stand at the new lot from 5 to 10 p.m., running the griddle.
entries.outcome: Good Thursday crowd from the Ruel Road yard workers.

entries.what: Filled the Taco at the Ruel Road station after closing the stand.
entries.outcome: Spent about $50 as usual.

entries.what: Free morning; he tinkered with the Taco and skimmed his G1 flashcards.
entries.outcome: Kept the study system going.

entries.what: Set up the stand at the new lot for the Friday evening crowd, running the griddle for the rush.
entries.outcome: Strong sales night.

entries.what: Left the stand at 8:50 to pick up Dulce from Taquería Colima and brought her home, back by 9:20.
entries.outcome: Dulce got home safe and he got back for teardown.

entries.what: Helped Gladys prep masa and loaded the truck for the Saturday stand.
entries.outcome: Ready on time.

entries.what: Worked the stand 5-10 p.m. with Ximena helping. The Thanksgiving food drive meant a busy day around town.
entries.outcome: Sold out of revueltas before closing.

entries.what: Ate leftover pupusas with extra curtido at home after teardown.
entries.outcome: Went to bed around midnight.

entries.what: Slept in, then helped his dad with truck and canopy maintenance before the Sunday stand.
entries.outcome: Fixed a loose canopy leg.

entries.what: Worked the Sunday stand 5-10 p.m. at the new lot.
entries.outcome: Closed out the week with a decent night.

entries.what: Wrote down his schedule for next week and ran his flashcards once more before bed.
entries.outcome: Set up for the coming week.
